selection_rationale: Nine of twelve mechanisms are killed, a 100% kill ratio among non-survivors. M786I-05 keeps arithmetic failure-event overlap for a dependent alteration, M786I-06 keeps deterministic largest-prime ownership together with lower-prime residue state, and M786I-12 keeps the full recursive token state and is the only route with a possible coherent infinite implementation. Pure defect thresholds, finite nested coarea, unaltered independent sampling, arbitrary packed-edge representatives, residue-free triangularity, single or adjacent active-degree strata, global rank, and fixed valuation cylinders are excluded by all-parameter counterfamilies or exact universal counterexamples.
